question.en: Which amphibian can survive complete dehydration?
question.ms: Amfibia manakah yang boleh hidup sepenuhnya tanpa air?

funFact.en: They can survive years in dried state and revive when water returns.
funFact.ms: Boleh hidup bertahun-tahun dalam keadaan kering dan kembali hidup apabila air muncul.

question.en: Which animal can regrow its lost body parts?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang boleh menumbuhkan semula bahagian badan yang hilang?

funFact.en: Starfish can regenerate arms if damaged or lost.
funFact.ms: Bintang laut boleh menumbuhkan semula lengan jika rosak atau hilang.

question.en: Which animal’s blood is green due to copper compounds?
question.ms: Darah haiwan manakah berwarna hijau kerana sebatian kuprum?

funFact.en: Some octopuses have greenish blood because of copper-based hemocyanin.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah gurita mempunyai darah kehijauan kerana hemocyanin berasaskan kuprum.

question.en: Which insect can survive underwater for weeks?
question.ms: Serangga manakah yang boleh hidup di bawah air selama beberapa minggu?

funFact.en: They trap air under their wings to breathe underwater for weeks.
funFact.ms: Menjerat udara di bawah sayap untuk bernafas di bawah air.

question.en: Which bird migrates the longest distance?
question.ms: Burung manakah yang berhijrah jarak paling jauh?

funFact.en: Arctic Terns travel about 70,000 km per year.
funFact.ms: Burung Tern Artik terbang kira-kira 70,000 km setahun.

question.en: Which animal has the fastest heartbeat?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang mempunyai degupan jantung paling cepat?

funFact.en: Hummingbirds can beat their heart up to 1,260 times per minute.
funFact.ms: Hummingbird boleh degup jantung sehingga 1,260 kali per minit.

question.en: Which animal has the longest tongue relative to its body?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang mempunyai lidah paling panjang berbanding badan?

funFact.en: Chameleons can extend their tongue longer than their body length to catch prey.
funFact.ms: Chameleon boleh hulurkan lidah lebih panjang dari badan untuk tangkap mangsa.

question.en: Which animal can survive in the vacuum of space?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang boleh hidup dalam vakum angkasa?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can survive extreme radiation, vacuum, and temperatures.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh hidup dalam radiasi, vakum, dan suhu ekstrem.

question.en: Which animal is known for the most powerful bite force?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang terkenal dengan daya gigitan paling kuat?

funFact.en: Saltwater crocodiles can bite with over 3,500 pounds of force.
funFact.ms: Buaya air masin boleh menggigit lebih 3,500 paun tekanan.

question.en: Which amphibian produces tetrodotoxin as a defense?
question.ms: Amfibia manakah menghasilkan tetrodotoksin untuk pertahanan?

funFact.en: Tetrodotoxin is a potent neurotoxin used to deter predators.
funFact.ms: Tetrodotoksin ialah neurotoksin kuat untuk menghalang pemangsa.

question.en: Which animal can survive being decapitated and continue moving?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup tanpa kepala dan terus bergerak?

funFact.en: Cockroaches have decentralized nerves that allow movement after decapitation.
funFact.ms: Lipeng mempunyai saraf tidak berpusat membolehkan gerakan selepas dipenggal kepala.

question.en: Which sea creature can clone itself by fragmentation?
question.ms: Haiwan laut manakah boleh menyalin dirinya melalui pemecahan?

funFact.en: Starfish can regenerate entire body parts through fragmentation.
funFact.ms: Bintang laut boleh menumbuhkan semula bahagian badan melalui pemecahan.

question.en: Which animal has the fastest nerve conduction?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai penghantaran saraf terpantas?

funFact.en: Giant axons in squid allow rapid nerve signaling.
funFact.ms: Axon gergasi sotong membolehkan isyarat saraf cepat.

question.en: Which bird has the largest wingspan?
question.ms: Burung manakah mempunyai julat sayap paling besar?

funFact.en: Its wingspan can reach up to 3.5 meters.
funFact.ms: Julat sayap boleh mencecah 3.5 meter.

question.en: Which plant is carnivorous and grows in nutrient-poor soil?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah yang karnivor dan hidup di tanah miskin nutrien?

funFact.en: Pitcher plants trap insects to gain nitrogen.
funFact.ms: Tumbuhan Pitcher perangkap serangga untuk dapatkan nitrogen.

question.en: Which animal is known for 'immortal' regeneration?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah terkenal dengan penjanaan semula 'abadi'?

funFact.en: Hydra can reproduce asexually and regenerate indefinitely.
funFact.ms: Hydra boleh membiak secara aseksual dan menumbuhkan semula tanpa had.

question.en: Which animal can survive freezing temperatures for years?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup dalam suhu beku bertahun-tahun?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can survive desiccation and freezing for years.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh hidup dalam kering dan beku bertahun-tahun.

question.en: Which microorganism can survive in nuclear reactors?
question.ms: Mikroorganisma manakah yang boleh hidup di reaktor nuklear?

funFact.en: It can survive extreme radiation doses that would kill humans.
funFact.ms: Ia boleh hidup dalam radiasi ekstrem yang membunuh manusia.

question.en: Which plant can survive complete immersion in saltwater?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh hidup sepenuhnya dalam air masin?

funFact.en: Mangroves excrete salt through leaves and roots.
funFact.ms: Bakau mengeluarkan garam melalui daun dan akar.

question.en: Which animal can survive without oxygen for months?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup tanpa oksigen selama berbulan-bulan?

funFact.en: Brine shrimp embryos enter cryptobiosis until conditions improve.
funFact.ms: Embrio udang garam masuk keadaan kriptobiosis sehingga keadaan membaik.

question.en: Which fungus can survive in space?
question.ms: Kulat manakah yang boleh hidup di angkasa?

funFact.en: Certain Aspergillus strains endure radiation and vacuum in space.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah strain Aspergillus tahan radiasi dan vakum di angkasa.

question.en: Which animal exhibits biological immortality through reverting its cells?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah menunjukkan keabadian biologi dengan mengembalikan selnya?

funFact.en: It can revert mature cells to a younger state repeatedly.
funFact.ms: Ia boleh mengembalikan sel matang ke keadaan muda berulang kali.

question.en: Which microorganism can metabolize radioactive material?
question.ms: Mikroorganisma manakah yang boleh metabolisme bahan radioaktif?

funFact.en: Some fungi thrive on gamma radiation in Chernobyl reactor walls.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah kulat hidup subur dengan radiasi gamma di dinding reaktor Chernobyl.

question.en: Which animal can survive both extreme heat and extreme cold?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup dalam haba dan sejuk ekstrem?

funFact.en: Tardigrades survive via anhydrobiosis and cryptobiosis.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade hidup melalui anhidrobiosis dan kriptobiosis.

question.en: Which animal can survive extreme vacuum without protection?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup dalam vakum ekstrem tanpa perlindungan?

funFact.en: Tardigrades endure space vacuum and radiation.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade tahan vakum angkasa dan radiasi.

question.en: Which organism can survive complete dehydration for decades?
question.ms: Organisma manakah boleh hidup sepenuhnya tanpa air selama beberapa dekad?

funFact.en: They enter a cryptobiotic state for decades until rehydrated.
funFact.ms: Masuk keadaan kriptobiosis selama beberapa dekad sehingga diberi air.

question.en: Which bacteria can survive extreme pressure in deep ocean?
question.ms: Bakteria manakah boleh hidup dalam tekanan ekstrem di lautan dalam?

funFact.en: Barophiles thrive at pressures over 1000 atmospheres.
funFact.ms: Barofil hidup subur pada tekanan melebihi 1000 atmosfera.

question.en: Which organism has the fastest known nerve impulse conduction?
question.ms: Organisma manakah mempunyai penghantaran impuls saraf terpantas yang diketahui?

funFact.en: Giant squid axons conduct signals faster than almost any other animal.
funFact.ms: Axon sotong gergasi hantar isyarat lebih cepat daripada hampir semua haiwan lain.

question.en: Which plant can survive in total darkness for months?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh hidup dalam kegelapan total selama beberapa bulan?

funFact.en: It gets nutrients from fungi, not photosynthesis.
funFact.ms: Mendapat nutrien dari kulat, bukan fotosintesis.

question.en: Which organism can survive boiling and freezing repeatedly?
question.ms: Organisma manakah boleh hidup mendidih dan membeku berulang kali?

funFact.en: They endure extreme temperature cycles through cryptobiosis.
funFact.ms: Tahan kitaran suhu ekstrem melalui kriptobiosis.

question.en: Which creature uses magnetic fields to navigate without eyesight?
question.ms: Makhluk manakah menggunakan medan magnet untuk navigasi tanpa penglihatan?

funFact.en: They detect Earth's magnetic field to travel across oceans.
funFact.ms: Mereka mengesan medan magnet Bumi untuk merentas lautan.

question.en: Which insect can survive complete decapitation for over a week?
question.ms: Serangga manakah boleh hidup sepenuhnya tanpa kepala lebih seminggu?

funFact.en: Their brain is mostly in the body ganglia, allowing survival.
funFact.ms: Otak terletak kebanyakannya di ganglia badan, membolehkan hidup.

question.en: Which microorganism thrives in both extreme cold and radiation?
question.ms: Mikroorganisma manakah hidup subur dalam sejuk ekstrem dan radiasi?

funFact.en: It is nicknamed 'Conan the Bacterium' for its toughness.
funFact.ms: Ia digelar 'Conan Bakteria' kerana ketahanan.

question.en: Which deep-sea fish can survive near boiling hydrothermal vents?
question.ms: Ikan laut dalam manakah boleh hidup berhampiran ventilasi hidrotermal mendidih?

funFact.en: They endure extreme heat, pressure, and sulfuric water.
funFact.ms: Hidup dalam haba ekstrem, tekanan, dan air bersulfur.

question.en: Which organism can survive complete dehydration, freezing, and radiation simultaneously?
question.ms: Organisma manakah boleh hidup tanpa air, beku, dan radiasi serentak?

funFact.en: It is considered the toughest known animal on Earth.
funFact.ms: Ia dianggap haiwan paling tahan di Bumi.

question.en: Which bacterium survives extreme cold, heat, radiation, and vacuum?
question.ms: Bakteria manakah hidup dalam sejuk, panas, radiasi, dan vakum ekstrem?

funFact.en: It can survive conditions lethal to almost all other life forms.
funFact.ms: Ia boleh hidup dalam keadaan yang membunuh hampir semua organisma lain.
